guarantees.claim: When rst_ni is low (reset), enables_q is cleared to all zeros.
guarantees.cond: rst_ni == 0 (on posedge clk_i or negedge rst_ni)

guarantees.claim: When cnt_set is asserted and not in reset, enables_q takes the value of enables_d.
When not in reset and cnt_set is deasserted, enables_q holds its previous value.

assumptions.claim: enables_d must be valid and stable when cnt_set is asserted to ensure correct sampled value.
assumptions.cond: cnt_set == 1 at a rising edge of clk_i
assumptions.risk: If enables_d changes during the cycle cnt_set is high, the captured enables_q could be a glitch or intermediate value, causing unexpected behavior in dependant logic.
